Longer term: 13 straight weeks of ETF inflows say big money is still buying the dips, building a floor around $4,000–$4,100.

The Gulf is still hot: two more tankers were attacked off Saudi Arabia on Friday (UKMTO).
items.reason_en: Near term: cheaper oil cools inflation fears and yields, cushioning gold around $4,160–$4,170, but peace headlines drain the haven bid, so don't expect a big pop. items.title_en: China's Q3 GDP grows 4.5%, beating the 4.4% forecast on exports – September retail sales +1.1%, industrial output +5.5%, factory prices +5% – gold barely reacts
items.summary_en: CNBC (Sunday, 10:05 PM ET): China's Q3 GDP grew 4.5% y/y (Q2: 4.3%, a three-year low; Reuters poll: 4.4%), putting nine-month growth at 4.6% – inside Beijing's 4.5%–5% target. September retail sales rose 1.1% (est. 0.6%), industrial output 5.5% (in line), urban unemployment 5.2%; fixed-asset investment fell 7.2% year-to-date and property investment 20.6%. The monthly trade surplus hit a record $133.5 billion; producer prices rose 5%, the fastest in over four years, while consumer inflation stays below 1%. NBS: Q3 GDP +1.2% q/q. Spot gold traded around 4,170–4,183 through the release (CNBC XAU=).
items.reason_en: Near term: a modest positive for metals demand, but not enough to set a trend – gold is still trading yields and the dollar. Longer term: a firmer China means less stimulus pressure, and 5% factory-gate inflation adds to global goods inflation – another reason central banks keep rates high.

items.title_en: Warsh at the IMF in Bangkok: 'I don't prejudge meetings' – no October hike signal, dollar slides to a near two-week low
items.summary_en: CNBC: in a fireside chat with IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh declined to say whether the Fed will hike again this month: 'I don't prejudge meetings. I don't believe in saying now what I might do at the meetings that we have in the balance of this year,' reiterating his opposition to forward guidance. He described a 'synchronous tightening' by central banks worldwide, meaning 'there's no free riders,' and said the Fed will deliver price stability. These were his last public remarks before the blackout starts Saturday ahead of the Oct 27–28 FOMC. FXStreet: the dollar came under fresh selling and gold drew dip buyers from the $4,150 area.
items.reason_en: Near term: no new hawkish signal, so the street is close to pricing out an October hike; a weaker dollar supports gold. But Warsh didn't rule a hike out either, so the data between now and Oct 28 calls the shots, and gold will swing hard on every print. Longer term: a Fed without forward guidance means bigger moves around each meeting, and synchronized global tightening remains a headwind for bullion.

Bigger picture: if the Houthis keep hitting Saudi oil infrastructure, crude can spike and pull rate-hike bets higher; if the US or Turkey gets drawn in and the war escalates, the safe-haven bid for gold should become clearer.

items.summary_en: Boston Fed President Susan Collins spoke 4:00–4:45 PM ET Oct 13 at the Boston Fed's regional banking conference. Reuters (4:01 PM ET): she backed September's hike to 3.75–4.00% and now thinks 'it would be appropriate to raise rates somewhat further before year-end to ensure inflation returns to the 2% target in a timely and sustainable way'. Timing depends on incoming data. She was upbeat on GDP growth and a labor market near full employment, but warned headline and core inflation will run above 2% for the next few months on refined fuels (jet, diesel, heating oil), AI investment, tariffs and the Middle East war. No same-day CNBC story; the full text wasn't on the Boston Fed site yet. items.reason_en: Clearly hawkish: Collins confirmed one more hike before end-2026 (the market leans December over the Oct 27–28 meeting). items.title: BlackRock nâng trái phiếu Mỹ lên 'tăng tỷ trọng' lần đầu sau ~6 năm, cho rằng thị trường cược Fed thắt chặt quá đà
items.summary: CNBC: BlackRock (quản lý hơn 15.300 tỷ USD) nâng khuyến nghị trái phiếu Chính phủ Mỹ lên overweight, hạ cổ phiếu Mỹ về trung lập. Hãng cho rằng kỳ vọng Fed tăng thêm 160 điểm cơ bản trong 12 tháng tới là 'quá đà', ưu tiên trái phiếu ngắn hạn. items.reason: Nếu dòng tiền lớn quay lại mua trái phiếu và kỳ vọng Fed thắt chặt hạ nhiệt, lợi suất có thể đã gần đỉnh → giảm chi phí cơ hội nắm giữ vàng, hỗ trợ vàng trung – dài hạn. Ngắn hạn đây mới là quan điểm, chưa thay đổi lộ trình Fed; CPI tuần này vẫn quyết định.

items.title_en: BlackRock goes overweight Treasuries for the first time in ~6 years, says markets overprice Fed tightening
items.summary_en: CNBC: BlackRock (over $15.3 trillion AUM) upgraded US Treasuries to overweight and cut US equities to neutral. The firm called expectations for another 160 bps of Fed hikes over the next 12 months 'overdone' and favors the short end. The 10-year yield is up about 110 bps year-to-date to around 5.25%, largely on high energy prices from the Middle East conflict.
items.reason_en: If big money rotates back into bonds and Fed-tightening bets cool, yields may be near a peak → lower opportunity cost for gold, supportive over the medium to long term. Near term it's just a view and doesn't change the Fed path; this week's CPI still decides.

items.title: IMF cảnh báo lợi suất trái phiếu chính phủ có thể tăng vọt 'mất trật tự' vì nợ công, lạm phát và vay nợ AI
items.summary: CNBC: Báo cáo Ổn định Tài chính Toàn cầu (GFSR) của IMF công bố 13/10 tại Bangkok cảnh báo nợ kỷ lục khiến thị trường trái phiếu 'dễ tổn thương trước các cú sốc tài khóa và lạm phát'; tỷ trọng nắm giữ trái phiếu Mỹ của quỹ phòng hộ tăng lên khoảng 9% (2025) từ 4% (2022), có nguy cơ 'tháo chạy mất trật tự'. Các hyperscaler AI chiếm 10% lượng phát hành trái phiếu hạng đầu tư toàn cầu (từ dưới 1% năm 2024), cạnh tranh vốn với trái phiếu chính phủ.
items.reason: Ngắn hạn: lợi suất tăng vọt gây áp lực lên vàng (chi phí cơ hội cao, USD mạnh) và có thể kéo theo bán tháo tài sản để lấy thanh khoản. Dài hạn: rủi ro nợ công và niềm tin vào trái phiếu chính phủ suy giảm là lý do cốt lõi để ngân hàng trung ương và nhà đầu tư giữ vàng làm tài sản an toàn.

items.summary_en: CNBC: the IMF's Global Financial Stability Report, released Oct 13 in Bangkok, warned record debt leaves bond markets 'vulnerable to fiscal and inflation shocks'; hedge funds' share of Treasury holdings rose to about 9% (2025) from 4% (2022), raising the risk of a 'disorderly unwind'. AI hyperscalers now account for 10% of global investment-grade bond issuance (from under 1% in 2024), competing with governments for capital.
items.reason_en: Near term: a yield spike pressures gold (higher opportunity cost, stronger dollar) and can trigger selling of assets to raise cash. Bigger picture: public-debt risk and eroding trust in government bonds are core reasons central banks and investors hold gold as a safe asset.

items.title_en: China buys gold for a 23rd straight month: about 23 tonnes added in September
items.summary_en: Reuters: the People's Bank of China's gold reserves rose to 77.47M oz at end-September from 76.73M oz at end-August – an addition of 740,000 oz (≈ 23 tonnes), more than in August – extending the buying streak to 23 months.
